schema.name: artifact_download_attempts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE artifact_download_attempts (
    download_attempt_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    artifact_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES document_artifacts(artifact_id),
    requested_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    final_url TEXT,
    started_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    fetched_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    elapsed_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (elapsed_ms >= 0),
    http_status INTEGER,
    response_headers_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    redirect_chain_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    declared_media_type TEXT,
    detected_media_type TEXT,
    byte_size INTEGER CHECK (byte_size IS NULL OR byte_size >= 0),
    content_sha256 TEXT,
    blob_id INTEGER REFERENCES response_blobs(blob_id),
    content_id INTEGER REFERENCES artifact_contents(content_id),
    result_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
      result_status IN (
        'validated', 'rejected_http_status', 'rejected_unexpected_html',
        'rejected_unknown_signature', 'rejected_declared_media_type',
        'rejected_artifact_type', 'too_large', 'timed_out', 'network_error'
      )
    ),
    limits_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    error_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    CHECK (
      result_status <> 'validated'
      OR (
        http_status = 200 AND detected_media_type IS NOT NULL
        AND content_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND blob_id IS NOT NULL
        AND content_id IS NOT NULL
      )
    ),
    CHECK (content_id IS NULL OR result_status = 'validated')
)

schema.name: artifact_download_queue
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE artifact_download_queue (
    download_job_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    artifact_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES document_artifacts(artifact_id),
    requested_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    target_host TEXT NOT NULL,
    priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
    scope_id TEXT NOT NULL
      REFERENCES artifact_download_scopes(scope_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (
      status IN (
        'PENDING', 'LEASED', 'SUCCEEDED', 'RETRYABLE_FAILURE',
        'TERMINAL_FAILURE', 'SKIPPED_ALREADY_HAVE_CONTENT', 'SKIPPED_POLICY'
      )
    ),
    attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
    next_attempt_at_utc TEXT,
    lease_owner TEXT,
    lease_expires_at_utc TEXT,

      )

    ),
    previous_quantity_decimal TEXT,

    current_weight_decimal TEXT,

schema.name: recording_normalizations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE recording_normalizations (
    normalization_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    artifact_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES document_artifacts(artifact_id),
    source_content_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES artifact_contents(content_id),
    normalized_content_id INTEGER UNIQUE REFERENCES artifact_contents(content_id),
    resolution_basis TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
      resolution_basis='primary_source_validated_download'
    ),
    probe_engine TEXT NOT NULL,
    probe_engine_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    normalizer_engine TEXT NOT NULL,
    normalizer_engine_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    options_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    completed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    normalization_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
      normalization_status IN ('accepted', 'failed')
    ),
    source_duration_ms INTEGER CHECK (
      source_duration_ms IS NULL OR source_duration_ms >= 0
    ),
    source_container_formats_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    source_streams_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    normalized_duration_ms INTEGER CHECK (
      normalized_duration_ms IS NULL OR normalized_duration_ms >= 0
    ),
    normalized_container_formats_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    normalized_streams_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    error_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    CHECK (
      (normalization_status='accepted'
       AND normalized_content_id IS NOT NULL
       AND source_duration_ms IS NOT NULL
       AND normalized_duration_ms IS NOT NULL)
      OR
      (normalization_status='failed' AND normalized_content_id IS NULL)
    ),
    UNIQUE(
      source_content_id, probe_engine, probe_engine_version,
      normalizer_engine, normalizer_engine_version, options_json
    )
)

CREATE TABLE "screener_company_queue" (

    origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'screener_screen'

    candidate_id INTEGER REFERENCES screener_result_candidates(candidate_id),
    exchange_filing_id INTEGER REFERENCES exchange_result_filings(filing_id),
    company_path_normalized TEXT NOT NULL,

    result_period TEXT NOT NULL,
    queue_reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (queue_reason IN ('new_company', 'result_period_advanced')),
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN (
      'pending', 'claimed', 'running', 'accepted', 'failed_retryable',
      'failed_terminal', 'manual_review', 'skipped_already_accepted'
    )),
    attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
    next_attempt_at_utc TEXT,
    claim_token TEXT UNIQUE,
    claimed_at_utc TEXT,
    claim_expires_at_utc TEXT,
    accepted_parse_id INTEGER REFERENCES parse_artifacts(parse_id),
    accepted_export_path TEXT,
    last_error_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL, collection_disposition TEXT,
    UNIQUE(company_path_normalized, reporting_scope, result_period),
    CHECK (
      (claim_token IS NULL AND claimed_at_utc IS NULL AND claim_expires_at_utc IS NULL)
      OR (claim_token IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND claim_expires_at_utc IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CHECK (
      (origin = 'screener_screen' AND candidate_id IS NOT NULL AND exchange_filing_id IS NULL)
      OR (origin = 'exchange_filing' AND exchange_filing_id IS NOT NULL AND candidate_id IS NULL)
    )

CREATE TRIGGER artifact_check_discovery_identity_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON artifact_check_events
WHEN NEW.discovered_artifact_id IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM artifact_expectations AS expectation
    JOIN artifact_events AS event USING (event_id)
    JOIN document_artifacts AS artifact
      ON artifact.artifact_id=NEW.discovered_artifact_id
    WHERE expectation.expectation_id=NEW.expectation_id
      AND artifact.company_id=expectation.company_id
      AND artifact.artifact_type=expectation.artifact_type
      AND (
        (event.event_date IS NOT NULL AND artifact.event_date=event.event_date)
        OR (event.period_end IS NOT NULL AND artifact.period_end=event.period_end)
        OR (event.fiscal_year IS NOT NULL AND event.fiscal_quarter IS NOT NULL
            AND artifact.fiscal_year=event.fiscal_year
            AND artifact.fiscal_quarter=event.fiscal_quarter)
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'discovered artifact does not match expectation') END;
END

schema.name: machine_transcription_run_insert_guard
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER machine_transcription_run_insert_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON machine_transcription_runs
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM document_artifacts
    WHERE artifact_id=NEW.transcript_artifact_id AND artifact_type='transcript'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'machine transcription target must be transcript artifact') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM document_artifacts
    WHERE artifact_id=NEW.recording_artifact_id AND artifact_type='recording'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'machine transcription source must be recording artifact') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM document_artifacts AS transcript_artifact
    JOIN document_artifacts AS recording_artifact
      ON recording_artifact.artifact_id=NEW.recording_artifact_id
    WHERE transcript_artifact.artifact_id=NEW.transcript_artifact_id
      AND transcript_artifact.company_id=recording_artifact.company_id
      AND (
        (transcript_artifact.event_date IS NOT NULL
         AND transcript_artifact.event_date=recording_artifact.event_date)
        OR
        (transcript_artifact.period_end IS NOT NULL
         AND transcript_artifact.period_end=recording_artifact.period_end)
        OR
        (transcript_artifact.fiscal_year IS NOT NULL
         AND transcript_artifact.fiscal_year=recording_artifact.fiscal_year
         AND transcript_artifact.fiscal_quarter IS NOT NULL
         AND transcript_artifact.fiscal_quarter=recording_artifact.fiscal_quarter)
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'recording and transcript event identity mismatch') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM document_artifacts AS transcript_artifact
    JOIN document_artifacts AS recording_artifact
      ON recording_artifact.artifact_id=NEW.recording_artifact_id
    WHERE transcript_artifact.artifact_id=NEW.transcript_artifact_id
      AND (
        (transcript_artifact.event_date IS NOT NULL
         AND recording_artifact.event_date IS NOT NULL
         AND transcript_artifact.event_date<>recording_artifact.event_date)
        OR
        (transcript_artifact.period_end IS NOT NULL
         AND recording_artifact.period_end IS NOT NULL
         AND transcript_artifact.period_end<>recording_artifact.period_end)
        OR
        (transcript_artifact.fiscal_year IS NOT NULL
         AND recording_artifact.fiscal_year IS NOT NULL
         AND transcript_artifact.fiscal_year<>recording_artifact.fiscal_year)
        OR
        (transcript_artifact.fiscal_quarter IS NOT NULL
         AND recording_artifact.fiscal_quarter IS NOT NULL
         AND transcript_artifact.fiscal_quarter<>recording_artifact.fiscal_quarter)
      )
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'recording and transcript event identity conflict') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM recording_normalizations AS normalization
    JOIN artifact_contents AS media
      ON media.content_id=normalization.normalized_content_id
    JOIN artifact_contents AS source
      ON source.content_id=normalization.source_content_id
    WHERE normalization.normalization_id=NEW.normalization_id
      AND normalization.artifact_id=NEW.recording_artifact_id
      AND normalization.normalization_status='accepted'
      AND normalization.normalized_content_id=NEW.source_media_content_id
      AND normalization.source_content_id=NEW.source_recording_content_id
      AND normalization.normalized_duration_ms=NEW.source_media_duration_ms
      AND media.content_sha256=NEW.source_media_sha256
      AND source.content_sha256=NEW.source_recording_sha256
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'machine transcription requires accepted normalized audio') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.transcript_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM transcripts
    WHERE transcript_id=NEW.transcript_id
      AND artifact_id=NEW.transcript_artifact_id
      AND origin='machine_generated'
      AND source_media_content_id=NEW.source_media_content_id
      AND engine=NEW.engine || '@' || NEW.engine_version
      AND model_version=NEW.model_version
      AND options_json=NEW.options_json
      AND validation_status=NEW.run_status
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'machine transcription transcript identity mismatch') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.generated_content_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM artifact_contents
    WHERE content_id=NEW.generated_content_id
      AND artifact_id=NEW.transcript_artifact_id
      AND is_official=0 AND content_origin='generated_derivative'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'machine transcription generated content mismatch') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.transcript_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM transcripts
    WHERE transcript_id=NEW.transcript_id
      AND content_id=NEW.generated_content_id
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'machine transcript content mismatch') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.comparison_requested=0 AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM transcripts
    WHERE artifact_id=NEW.transcript_artifact_id
      AND origin='official' AND validation_status='accepted'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'usable official transcript blocks machine transcription') END;
END

schema.name: recording_normalization_identity_insert_guard

CREATE TRIGGER recording_normalization_identity_insert_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON recording_normalizations
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM document_artifacts
    WHERE artifact_id=NEW.artifact_id AND artifact_type='recording'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'recording normalization requires recording artifact') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM artifact_contents
    WHERE content_id=NEW.source_content_id
      AND artifact_id=NEW.artifact_id
      AND is_official=1
      AND content_origin='publisher_original'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'recording source must be official publisher content') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM artifact_download_attempts AS attempt
    JOIN artifact_download_attempt_sources AS link USING (download_attempt_id)
    JOIN artifact_sources AS source USING (artifact_source_id)
    WHERE attempt.content_id=NEW.source_content_id
      AND attempt.artifact_id=NEW.artifact_id
      AND attempt.result_status='validated'
      AND source.is_primary_source=1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'recording source requires validated primary-source download') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.normalized_content_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM artifact_contents
    WHERE content_id=NEW.normalized_content_id
      AND artifact_id=NEW.artifact_id
      AND media_type='audio/wav'
      AND is_official=0
      AND content_origin='generated_derivative'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'normalized audio must be a generated WAV derivative') END;
END

schema.name: transcript_identity_insert_guard

CREATE TRIGGER transcript_identity_insert_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON transcripts
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM document_artifacts
    WHERE artifact_id=NEW.artifact_id AND artifact_type='transcript'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'transcript requires transcript artifact') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM artifact_contents
    WHERE content_id=NEW.content_id AND artifact_id=NEW.artifact_id
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'transcript content must belong to artifact') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.origin='official' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM artifact_contents AS content
    JOIN document_extractions AS extraction USING (content_id)
    WHERE content.content_id=NEW.content_id
      AND content.is_official=1
      AND content.content_origin='publisher_original'
      AND extraction.extraction_id=NEW.extraction_id
      AND extraction.extraction_status='ok'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'official transcript requires usable official extraction') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.origin='machine_generated' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM artifact_contents AS content
    WHERE content.content_id=NEW.content_id
      AND content.artifact_id=NEW.artifact_id
      AND content.is_official=0
      AND content.content_origin='generated_derivative'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'machine transcript requires generated derivative content') END;
END

SELECT fs.*
FROM mf_stock_month_feature_sets AS fs
WHERE fs.aggregation_status='generated'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM mf_stock_month_feature_inputs AS input
    WHERE input.feature_set_id=fs.feature_set_id
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mf_stock_month_feature_inputs AS input
    LEFT JOIN mf_current_scheme_month_change_sets AS current_set
      ON current_set.change_set_id=input.change_set_id
    WHERE input.feature_set_id=fs.feature_set_id
      AND current_set.change_set_id IS NULL
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mf_current_scheme_month_change_sets AS current_set
    LEFT JOIN mf_stock_month_feature_inputs AS input
      ON input.feature_set_id=fs.feature_set_id
     AND input.change_set_id=current_set.change_set_id
    WHERE current_set.publisher=fs.publisher
      AND current_set.previous_month=fs.previous_month
      AND current_set.current_month=fs.current_month
      AND input.change_set_id IS NULL
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mf_stock_month_feature_inputs AS input
    WHERE input.feature_set_id=fs.feature_set_id
      AND input.scheme_classification_id != (
        SELECT MAX(classification.scheme_classification_id)
        FROM mf_scheme_classifications AS classification
        WHERE classification.scheme_id=input.scheme_id
          AND classification.valid_from_month<=fs.current_month
          AND (
            classification.valid_to_month IS NULL
            OR classification.valid_to_month>=fs.current_month
          )
      )
  )

schema.name: mf_holding_source_evidence
schema.sql:
CREATE VIEW mf_holding_source_evidence AS
SELECT
  'official:' || holding.holding_id AS observation_key,
  holding.holding_id AS source_observation_id,
  holding.publisher,
  holding.scheme_id,
  holding.scheme_code,
  holding.disclosure_month,
  holding.security_id,
  holding.security_name_raw,
  holding.isin_normalized,
  holding.quantity_decimal,
  holding.market_value_decimal AS market_value_lakh_decimal,
  holding.percentage_of_nav_decimal,
  holding.source,
  holding.source_quality,
  1 AS source_precedence_rank,
  1 AS is_preferred
FROM mf_accepted_holdings AS holding
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'mfdata:' || holding.mfdata_holding_id AS observation_key,
  holding.mfdata_holding_id AS source_observation_id,
  holding.publisher,
  holding.scheme_id,
  holding.scheme_code,
  holding.disclosure_month,
  holding.security_id,
  holding.security_name_raw,
  holding.isin_normalized,
  holding.quantity_decimal,
  holding.market_value_lakh_decimal,
  holding.percentage_of_nav_decimal,
  holding.source,
  holding.source_quality,
  2 AS source_precedence_rank,
  CASE
    WHEN holding.security_id IS NULL
      OR holding.isin_validation_status != 'valid' THEN 0
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mf_accepted_holdings AS official
      WHERE official.publisher=holding.publisher
        AND official.scheme_id=holding.scheme_id
        AND official.disclosure_month=holding.disclosure_month
        AND official.isin_normalized=holding.isin_normalized
    ) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS is_preferred
FROM mf_current_mfdata_holdings AS holding
